title: ctenitis ochrorachis
intro: Ctenitis ochrorachis, commonly known as the Asian Brake, is a species of fern found in East Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a popular choice for traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis ochrorachis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
